subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: If the write throttle saturates (burst exceeds the budget), then the system shall queue and delay writes, surfacing backpressure and queue depth as events; never drop a write, never let a platform rate-limit response occur
fit_criterion: replaces UB-6, whose criterion never checked the depth it required the system to surface: the FR-8 burst fixture — zero drops, zero platform 429s, queue drains — **and** a deterministic depth fixture: with N > 1 writers held concurrently in deferral on one ledger, an emitted throttle_deferred reports queue_depth = N; no run in which more than one writer is concurrently deferred reports a maximum depth of 1
